source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide whether an object at rest must have no force acting on it.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: An object can remain at rest while unbalanced forces act on it.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Stopping an object automatically makes all the forces on it balance.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: A moving object cannot have balanced forces.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: No force acts on the book because it is not moving.

intelligence.enrichment: An object being at rest does not mean that no force acts on it; the forces acting on the object may be balancing one another. forces balance one another -> object can remain at rest The learner correctly applies this rule: An object being at rest does not mean that no force acts on it; the forces acting on the object may be balancing one another. If an object is not moving, no force can be acting on it.
